args.subject: Your refund for transaction T00028 has been approved
args.body:
Dear Rohan Mehta,

We are writing to let you know that the refund for transaction T00028 has been approved.

If you have any questions, please contact the support desk and quote your customer ID (C002) and the transaction reference (T00028).

Regards,
Support Desk

replies:
The approval email for transaction T00028 went to Rohan Mehta (C002) at his registered address, rohan.mehta57@example.com, at 19:36 IST on 28 October 2026.

The email confirms the refund is approved and asks him to quote C002 and T00028 if he has questions. It doesn't include the refund amount or expected timing, because I didn't check the transaction details before sending.
